sentences.text: No. NOT 01. 10.01.2025 BSB, J  M.A.C.M.A.No.18 of 2025
The learned counsel for the appellant is permitted to take out personal service of notice to the respondents through registered post with acknowledgement due and file proof thereof.

This application is filed to grant stay of decree and judgment dated 09-09-2024 passed in M.V.O.P.No.411/2022 on the file of Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal-Cum-Family Court-Cum-VI-Additional District Judge, Kadapa.

entities.text: Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal-Cum-Family Court-Cum-VI-Additional District Judge, Kadapa
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner/ appellant submitted that the tribunal erred in awarding compensation though the claim was made under Section 163-A of the Motor Vehicles Act and Rule.455 and 475 (2) of Andhra Pradesh Motor Vehicles Rules and the deceased was not the insured party but merely stepped into the shoes of the insured/owner and he himself was at fault.
He further submitted that the amount awarded is high side.

For the reasons stated in the grounds of appeal and the above said argument, the interim stay as prayed for is granted on the condition that petitioner/appellant shall deposit 50% of the awarded amount as per the decree within eight (08) weeks from the date of this Order, failing which, the interim stay granted gets vacated without any further orders.
